issue_context.title: The left join result is incorrect
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)
```mysql
create table t0(col1 varchar(255));
create table t1(col1 int(11));
insert into t0 values("\\9jM\\M");
insert into t1 values(0);
insert into t1 values(null);
insert into t1 values(null);
```
<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
```mysql
mysql> select t0.col1, t1.col1 from t0 left join t1 on t0.col1 not like t0.col1;
+--------+------+
| col1   | col1 |
+--------+------+
| \9jM\M | NULL |
| \9jM\M | NULL |
| \9jM\M |    0 |
+--------+------+
3 rows in set (0.06 sec)

```
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```mysql
mysql> select t0.col1, t1.col1 from t0 left join t1 on t0.col1 not like t0.col1;
+--------+------+
| col1   | col1 |
+--------+------+
| \9jM\M | NULL |
+--------+------+
1 row in set (0.10 sec)

```
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
```mysql
Release Version: v4.0.0-beta.2-2780-gc5ca2ea7f
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: c5ca2ea7f91786f682c448aebfd07513af20c40e
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2021-04-29 16:36:57
GoVersion: go1.13
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false
```
<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
comments:
I am not sure about the correctness of the following sql:
```mysql
mysql> select * from t0 where t0.col1 not like t0.col1;
+--------+
| col1   |
+--------+
| \9jM\M |
+--------+
1 row in set (0.12 sec)

```

> I am not sure about the correctness of the following sql:
> 
> ```sql
> mysql> select * from t0 where t0.col1 not like t0.col1;
> +--------+
> | col1   |
> +--------+
> | \9jM\M |
> +--------+
> 1 row in set (0.12 sec)
> ```

it can be explained, 
```sql
mysql> select '\\9jM\\M' like '\\9jM\\M';
+----------------------------+
| '\\9jM\\M' like '\\9jM\\M' |
+----------------------------+
|                          0 |
+----------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)

mysql> select '\\9jM\\M' = '\\9jM\\M';
+-------------------------+
| '\\9jM\\M' = '\\9jM\\M' |
+-------------------------+
|                       1 |
+-------------------------+
1 row in set (0.00 sec)
```
`like` is different from `=`, the second parameter of `like` will be treated as a pattern, so that `\9jM\M = 9jMM`
@xiongjiwei PTAL. Looks like out pattern compilation logic is not compatible.

the root cause is function https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/6154335ac01731bdcfdabbb978cd121f656956d2/util/stringutil/string_util.go#L155
we do not implement it correctly

review_comments: Why do you delete it? How does it work?

before this PR, we compile the pattern
```
\% -> %
% -> any
a -> a
\a -> \a
```
after
```
\% -> %
% -> any
a -> a
\a -> a
```

so that SQL `select 'a' like '\\a'` is true.
